name: Independence Cube Open 2019

venue.name: Magneto Mall
venue.address: Magneto Mall, GE Road Labhandih, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492001

information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
On-the-spot (OTS) registration will be also be available as per the times mentioned in the [Schedule Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndependenceCubeOpen2019#competition-schedule) for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, Skewb and Pyraminx. The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndependenceCubeOpen2019#11074-registrations-payments). 

Please note once you register in WCA site for the Independence Cube Championship 2019, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.



***Quick Info links:***
[**Event Schedule**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndependenceCubeOpen2019#competition-schedule)
**[Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndependenceCubeOpen2019#11074-registrations-payments)**
